title: Initial language membership characterization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $x,w$ be Boolean words and $s$ a natural number. The word obtained by pairing $x$ with the pairing of $w$ and the binary word for $s$ belongs to the initial language of $N$ if and only if $w$ satisfies the initial-check conditions for $N$, $x$, and $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
